$schema note: Exact inventory of Tool input-schema refinements. z.toJSONSchema drops .refine/.superRefine, so a rule expressed only that way is invisible to the model at call time. Every refinement must appear here, classified by a human: `documented` means the rule is stated in text the model can read (a field .describe() or the Tool description). Regenerate the id list with `pnpm verify:tool-refinement-visibility --write`, then classify by hand. Nothing is inferred from prose.
